_doc: Targets an oracle still tracks on purpose although the scorer no longer produces them (the contract cannot remove a target). The Watch lists them apart as retired: they are not counted stale and not counted in the methodology hashes in use. Key: <oracle-slug>:<target address, any case>. last_update_at_retirement is the lastUpdated read on chain when the target was retired: a later value means the target was written again, and the Watch counts it as a normal target again and alerts until this file is edited. Kept by hand after reading the contract. See scripts/lib/retired.py.
